audit.whatIsWrong: Stored chart is Skill / Riven / Riven / Skill / Skill / Riven / Riven in both layers. The mirror set Level 6 to Riven, First item to Skill and 2+ items to Wukong as three matched pairs, which is packet.levelChart exactly. Rows 4, 5 and 6 disagree.
audit.why: This page's whys already state the mirror's chart — whys[4] 'lets her win an even all-in', whys[5] 'First item is even', whys[6] 'Two-plus items you win'. Three rows printed a winner their own sentence denied, and 57.68% over 371 games supports the Wukong two-item row.
audit.corrected: Flipped row 4 to Riven, row 5 to Skill and row 6 to Wukong in BOTH layers as one atomic paired group, with row 4's rating to 3/10 and row 6's to 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Blade of the Exile is described as 'adds range and the Wind Slash execute', and Wind Slash is treated as a repeatable threat. Riot's text says she gains Attack Damage and Range, and gains the ability to use Wind Slash — a powerful ranged attack — ONCE. It says nothing about an execute.
audit.why: One use per ultimate is the whole level 6 read: once she has thrown Wind Slash, the ranged threat is gone for the rest of that R and the remaining window is a melee fight with more AD and range. A player who thinks it is repeatable never steps back in.
audit.corrected: Restated Wind Slash as one ranged cast per Blade of the Exile with the R's real 120/90/60s cooldown, and dropped the unsupported 'execute' framing — matching the correction the mirror already made from its side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Runic Blade is absent from the page entirely, while 'animation-cancel burst' is referenced twice as if it were an unexplained trick. Her passive is the mechanism: her ABILITIES CHARGE HER BLADE and her BASIC ATTACKS SPEND those charges for bonus damage. Also missing: Broken Wings is a flat 13-second cooldown for the whole three-cast chain, and its THIRD cast knocks back.
audit.why: The passive is why weaving an auto between every cast is not showmanship but her actual damage, and it gives you the read — each ability she throws loads a charge she must then auto you to spend, so the dangerous moment is the auto, not the cast. And 13 seconds for the entire Q chain is the biggest punish window she has: once the third cast knocks back, she has no dash for that whole window.
audit.corrected: Wrote Runic Blade's charge-and-spend loop into the spikes and prose, gave Broken Wings its flat 13s and the third-cast knockback, and added Ki Burst's 260 range on 11/10/9/8/7s and Valor's 250 range on 10/9/8/7/6s.
sources: enemyKit P/Q/W/E text, ranges and cooldowns

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t ends 'Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern.' There is no healing anywhere in Riven's kit: passive is bonus attack damage, Q is damage, W is a stun, E is a step plus damage block, R is AD and range. No heal flag appears on any of her five abilities.
audit.why: This sends the player to buy a Grievous Wounds item against a champion with nothing to reduce — real gold, spent on a stat that does zero in this matchup, in the exact lane where a Doran's or an early component decides the level 3 spike.
audit.corrected: Removed the anti-heal recommendation from the itemization line and left the rest of the build intact.
sources: enemyKit P/Q/W/E/R text and flags — no heal on any ability

audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into the don'ts, the do's, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t.

notes: Two findings here are worth a human's attention beyond the usual. First, the page told the player to buy Executioner's Calling early against Riven 'because his healing fights your pattern' — Riven has no healing on any of her five abilities, so that is real gold spent on a dead stat in a lane decided by the level 3 spike; the same boilerplate anti-heal sentence appears on several other Wukong pages and is worth grepping for across the champion. Second, the page referenced her 'animation-cancel burst' twice without ever naming Runic Blade, which is the mechanism: abilities charge the blade, autos spend the charge. Naming it turns an unexplained trick into a read. The 'Wind Slash execute' framing was dropped rather than restated — Riot's text calls it a powerful ranged attack usable once, and says nothing about missing-health scaling, so the execute claim is unverified. Also unverified and therefore untouched: whether Cyclone's knockup actually interrupts Broken Wings mid-chain (the page asserts it in three places), and whether Valor's damage block stops your Q. Note packet.games is 371 while the brief header says 2114.
